lessons.title: Lesson 10: Learning from Older and Younger People
lessons.topic: Learning from Older and Younger People
lessons.passage: Every generation has valuable knowledge to share. Older people have life experience, practical skills, and stories about family traditions. Younger people often bring new ideas, digital skills, and an open-minded attitude. When both sides respect these strengths, their relationship becomes closer. In my family, my grandmother teaches me traditional recipes and tells me how life has changed. In return, I help her use online maps and send photos to relatives. These simple exchanges show that the generation gap is not always a problem. It can become an opportunity for family members to understand different values and grow together.

Người trẻ thường mang đến ý tưởng mới, kỹ năng số và thái độ cởi mở. Khi hai bên tôn trọng những điểm mạnh này, mối quan hệ trở nên gần gũi hơn. Trong gia đình em, bà dạy em các công thức truyền thống và kể cuộc sống đã thay đổi như thế nào. Đổi lại, em giúp bà dùng bản đồ trực tuyến và gửi ảnh cho họ hàng. Những trao đổi đơn giản cho thấy khoảng cách thế hệ không phải lúc nào cũng là vấn đề; nó có thể trở thành cơ hội để hiểu các giá trị khác nhau và cùng trưởng thành.

lessons.title: Lesson 9: Solving Family Conflicts
lessons.passage: Family conflicts are normal, especially when teenagers want more freedom. A small disagreement can become a serious argument if people shout, interrupt, or use hurtful words. To solve a conflict, we should first control our behaviour and listen to the other person's explanation. Then we can describe our feelings clearly without blaming anyone. Good communication includes respect, honesty, and a willingness to compromise. For example, a teenager may agree to complete schoolwork before going out, while parents may allow a later return time at weekends. A fair solution does not give one person everything; it considers the needs of the whole family.

lessons.title: Lesson 8: Technology in Different Generations
lessons.passage: Technology can widen the generation gap, but it can also connect family members. Young people use digital devices and social media for study, entertainment, and communication. Older people may worry about privacy, online safety, and too much screen time. Their concerns are understandable. At the same time, adults can adapt to useful technology when teenagers guide them patiently. For example, a grandchild can teach a grandparent to make a video call, while the grandparent can share advice about responsible behaviour. Instead of criticising each other's viewpoint, families should agree on sensible rules and use technology as a tool for learning and connection.

lessons.title: Lesson 7: Family Rules and Responsibilities
lessons.passage: Family rules help people live together safely and respectfully. In my family, I have to finish my homework, help with household chores, and tell my parents when I come home late. Sometimes I think a rule is too strict, and this may lead to an argument. However, I try to understand the reason behind it. Parents usually create rules because they care about their children's safety and future. Teenagers should obey reasonable rules, but parents should also listen to our opinions. A family works best when responsibilities are shared and rules are discussed calmly instead of being imposed without explanation.

lessons.title: Lesson 5: A Healthy School Campaign
lessons.passage: My class would like to organise a Healthy School Campaign. First, we will invite students to examine their daily habits through a short survey. Then we will share posters about balanced meals, fitness, handwashing, and safe food. One activity will explain how tiny organisms can cause disease and food poisoning when food is not stored properly. Another activity will be a friendly exercise challenge in which students record their walking or cycling time. The campaign will not judge anyone. Its purpose is to provide practical information and encourage small changes. I believe a healthier school begins when students support one another and turn useful knowledge into action.

lessons.title: Lesson 4: Sleep and Stress Management
lessons.passage: A long and healthy life depends on more than food and exercise. Good sleep and stress management are also important. Many students stay up late to study or use social media, but this habit reduces their energy the next day. Teenagers should keep a regular bedtime and give up using phones just before sleep. When we feel stressed, we can take a short walk, listen to music, talk to someone we trust, or practise deep breathing. These simple methods are not medical treatment, but they help us relax and protect our mental health. Healthy daily habits can improve our quality of life and may even support a longer life expectancy.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Exercise and Fitness
lessons.passage: Regular exercise is essential for both physical and mental health. Teenagers do not need expensive equipment to improve their fitness. We can work out at home by doing press-ups, star jumps, squats, or simple stretching. These activities strengthen our muscles and increase our energy. Playing badminton, football, or cycling with friends can also make exercise more enjoyable. However, we should warm up carefully and choose activities that are suitable for our health condition. I try to exercise for at least thirty minutes most days. This regular routine helps me sleep better, concentrate in class, and feel more confident.

lessons.title: Lesson 1: A Balanced Diet for Teenagers
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today I would like to talk about a balanced diet for teenagers. Our bodies need different nutrients to grow and study effectively. A healthy meal should include vegetables, fruit, protein, and a suitable amount of carbohydrates. We should check the ingredients in packaged food and choose simple recipes with fresh products. It is also important to cut down on sugar, salt, and fast food. When we eat properly, we have more energy, maintain a healthy weight, and reduce the risk of disease. In my opinion, healthy eating is not a strict rule. It is a sensible habit that we can build every day.

lessons.title: Lesson 49: The Benefits and Problems of Ecotourism
lessons.topic: The Benefits and Problems of Ecotourism
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about the benefits and problems of ecotourism. Ecotourism can bring many positive impacts. It helps protect natural resources, supports local communities and teaches tourists about the environment. Local people can earn money by working as tour guides, selling local products or offering homestay services. These are long-term benefits if tourism is managed well. However, ecotourism can also have negative effects if tourists are irresponsible. Too many visitors may leave litter, waste resources or disturb wildlife. To make ecotourism truly sustainable, both tourists and travel companies must follow clear rules. In my opinion, ecotourism is a good choice, but it must be planned carefully. We should enjoy nature and protect it at the same time. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 47: Staying in a Homestay
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about staying in a homestay. A homestay is a place where tourists stay with a local family. It is a good choice for ecotourism because tourists can learn about local culture, food and daily life. When staying in a homestay, tourists should respect local customs. They should speak politely, follow house rules and avoid wasting water or electricity. They can also support the local community by buying local products or using local services. Homestays can have a positive impact because they create jobs and bring income to local people. In my opinion, staying in a homestay is more than finding a place to sleep. It is a chance to understand people, culture and responsible tourism. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 45: An Environmental Club at School
lessons.passage: Good morning, teacher and friends. Today, I would like to introduce an environmental club at school. The club is called “Young Green Protectors”. Its goal is to help students understand environmental problems and take action. Members can organise campaigns about saving energy, reducing plastic waste and protecting biodiversity. They can also invite teachers to give talks about wildlife conservation and climate change. Every month, the club can choose one practical activity, such as planting trees, cleaning the school yard or making posters. These activities are simple, but they can raise awareness among students. I think every school should have an environmental club. It gives students a chance to learn, act and become responsible citizens. Protecting the environment should begin at school and continue in daily life. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 44: Extreme Weather and Climate Change
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about extreme weather and climate change. Climate change is one of the biggest environmental problems in the world. It affects the Earth’s atmosphere and can cause global warming. As a result, many places experience extreme weather, such as heatwaves, storms, floods and droughts. These events can damage houses, farms and people’s health. To reduce climate change, we should save energy, use public transport, plant trees and reduce waste. Factories and companies should also use cleaner energy. Students can take action by joining environmental clubs and sharing green messages with friends. Although we are young, our actions still matter. If many people make an effort, we can protect the planet together. Thank you for listening.

exercise.translation:
Xin chào tất cả mọi người. Hôm nay, em sẽ nói về thời tiết cực đoan và biến đổi khí hậu. Biến đổi khí hậu là một trong những vấn đề môi trường lớn nhất trên thế giới. Nó ảnh hưởng đến khí quyển của Trái Đất và có thể gây ra nóng lên toàn cầu. Kết quả là nhiều nơi trải qua thời tiết cực đoan, như nắng nóng, bão, lũ lụt và hạn hán. Những hiện tượng này có thể gây thiệt hại cho nhà cửa, nông trại và sức khỏe con người. Để giảm biến đổi khí hậu, chúng ta nên tiết kiệm năng lượng, sử dụng phương tiện công cộng, trồng cây và giảm rác thải. Các nhà máy và công ty cũng nên sử dụng năng lượng sạch hơn. Học sinh có thể hành động bằng cách tham gia câu lạc bộ môi trường và chia sẻ thông điệp xanh với bạn bè. Mặc dù chúng ta còn trẻ, hành động của chúng ta vẫn có ý nghĩa. Nếu nhiều người cùng nỗ lực, chúng ta có thể bảo vệ hành tinh cùng nhau. Cảm ơn cô và các bạn đã lắng nghe. HỌC VIỆN MINH CHÂU • ENGLISH DICTATION IMPORT READY An Environmental Club at School

lessons.title: Lesson 43: The Effects of Deforestation
lessons.passage: Good morning, everyone. Today, I would like to talk about the effects of deforestation. Deforestation means cutting down too many trees. This problem has serious consequences for nature and people. First, many animals lose their habitats when forests disappear. Second, deforestation can lead to soil erosion and floods, especially during heavy rain. Third, forests absorb carbon dioxide, so losing forests can make global warming and climate change worse. To reduce deforestation, people should plant more trees and protect natural forests. We should also use paper and wooden products carefully. Students can join tree-planting activities and make posters about forest protection. In my opinion, forests are like the lungs of the Earth. Protecting forests means protecting our future. Thank you for listening.

Kính chào tất cả mọi người. Hôm nay, em muốn nói về tác động của nạn phá rừng. Phá rừng có nghĩa là chặt quá nhiều cây. Vấn đề này có những hậu quả nghiêm trọng đối với thiên nhiên và con người. Thứ nhất, nhiều loài động vật mất môi trường sống khi rừng biến mất. Thứ hai, phá rừng có thể dẫn đến xói mòn đất và lũ lụt, đặc biệt trong những trận mưa lớn. Thứ ba, rừng hấp thụ khí carbon dioxide, vì vậy mất rừng có thể làm cho hiện tượng nóng lên toàn cầu và biến đổi khí hậu trở nên tồi tệ hơn. Để giảm phá rừng, con người nên trồng nhiều cây hơn và bảo vệ rừng tự nhiên. Chúng ta cũng nên sử dụng giấy và các sản phẩm gỗ một cách cẩn thận. Học sinh có thể tham gia các hoạt động trồng cây và làm áp phích về bảo vệ rừng. Theo em, rừng giống như lá phổi của Trái Đất. Bảo vệ rừng có nghĩa là bảo vệ tương lai của chúng ta. lessons.title: Lesson 42: Plastic Pollution in the Ocean
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about plastic pollution in the ocean. Plastic pollution is a serious environmental issue. Many plastic bags, bottles and packages are thrown into rivers and then carried to the sea. As a consequence, marine life is badly affected. Turtles may mistake plastic bags for food, and fish can be harmed by small pieces of plastic. To solve this problem, we should reduce single-use plastic and recycle plastic products properly. People should not throw rubbish into rivers, beaches or public places. Schools can organise environmental campaigns to teach students about ocean protection. I think we need to take action immediately because the ocean is home to many living things. Protecting the ocean means protecting life on Earth. Thank you for listening.

Nhiều túi nhựa, chai nhựa và bao bì bị vứt xuống sông rồi trôi ra biển. Hậu quả là sinh vật biển bị ảnh hưởng nặng nề. lessons.title: Lesson 41: Protecting Endangered Animals in Viet Nam
lessons.topic: Protecting Endangered Animals in Viet Nam
lessons.passage: Good morning, teacher and friends. Today, I would like to talk about protecting endangered animals in Viet Nam. Viet Nam has rich biodiversity, but some animals are now endangered because of habitat loss, pollution and illegal hunting. If we do not protect them, some species may face extinction. Wild animals are important because each species has a role in the ecosystem. To protect them, people should stop buying products made from wild animals. Forests and natural habitats should be protected. The government should have strict rules against illegal hunting. Students can also help by learning about wildlife conservation and raising awareness in their schools. I believe protecting endangered animals is not only about saving animals. It is also about keeping the natural balance for future generations. Thank you for listening.

Việt Nam có sự đa dạng sinh học phong phú, nhưng một số loài động vật hiện đang bị đe dọa do mất môi trường sống, ô nhiễm và săn bắt trái phép. Nếu chúng ta không bảo vệ chúng, một số loài có thể đối mặt với sự tuyệt chủng. Động vật hoang dã rất quan trọng vì mỗi loài đều có một vai trò trong hệ sinh thái. Để bảo vệ chúng, con người nên ngừng mua các sản phẩm làm từ động vật hoang dã. Rừng và môi trường sống tự nhiên nên được bảo vệ. Chính phủ nên có các quy định nghiêm ngặt chống lại săn bắt trái phép. Học sinh cũng có thể giúp bằng cách tìm hiểu về bảo tồn động vật hoang dã và nâng cao nhận thức trong trường học. Em tin rằng bảo vệ động vật nguy cấp không chỉ là cứu động vật. Đó cũng là giữ gìn cân bằng tự nhiên cho các thế hệ tương lai. Cảm ơn cô và các bạn đã lắng nghe. lessons.title: Lesson 40: Digital Homework
lessons.passage: Good morning, teacher and friends. Today, I would like to talk about digital homework. In many schools, teachers now use online platforms to manage homework. Students can upload assignments, submit answers and receive feedback from teachers. This way of learning is convenient because students do not always need printed papers. Teachers can also share learning materials quickly. In a virtual classroom, students can ask questions and review old lessons. However, digital homework requires responsibility. Students should submit their work on time and should not copy from the Internet. Parents and teachers can support students, but students must do the work themselves. I think digital homework is a useful part of modern education if we use it honestly and effectively. Thank you for listening.

Học sinh có thể tải bài làm lên, nộp câu trả lời và nhận phản hồi từ giáo viên. Cách học này thuận tiện vì học sinh không phải lúc nào cũng cần giấy in. Giáo viên cũng có thể chia sẻ tài liệu học tập nhanh chóng. Trong một lớp học ảo, học sinh có thể đặt câu hỏi và ôn lại bài cũ. Tuy nhiên, bài tập kỹ thuật số đòi hỏi trách nhiệm. lessons.title: Lesson 39: My Learning Style
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about my learning style. Every student has a different learning style. Some students learn best by listening, while others learn better through pictures, videos or practice. I like interactive lessons because I can ask questions and communicate with my classmates. I also like self-study because it helps me become an independent learner. At home, I often watch short English videos, write new words in a notebook and review them regularly. When I do exercises online, I like receiving feedback because it shows me what I need to improve. I think students should understand their own learning style. When we know how we learn best, we can choose suitable methods and study more effectively. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 38: Managing Screen Time
lessons.passage: Good morning, everyone. Today, I would like to talk about managing screen time. Digital devices are very useful for learning, but too much screen time can be harmful. Students may feel tired, lose concentration or spend too much time on entertainment. Social media and games can become big distractions. To manage screen time, we should make a clear timetable. We can use digital devices for online lessons, homework and research, but we should also take breaks. After studying online, we should rest our eyes, do exercise or talk with family members. Good time management helps students balance study and health. In my opinion, technology should support our learning, not control our life. Self-discipline is the key to using digital devices wisely. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 37: Choosing Reliable Online Resources
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about choosing reliable online resources. The Internet gives students quick access to a lot of information, but not everything online is correct. When we search for learning materials, we should choose reliable websites, official sources or resources recommended by teachers. We should check the author, the date and the purpose of the information. For English learning, students can use online dictionaries, educational platforms and school materials. We should not copy information without understanding it. Instead, we should read carefully and use it to support our own ideas. Choosing reliable resources is an important skill in online learning. It helps students study more effectively and avoid wrong information. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 36: A Blended Learning Week
lessons.passage: Good morning, teacher and friends. Today, I would like to talk about a blended learning week. Blended learning combines face-to-face learning and online learning. For example, on Monday and Wednesday, students can study with teachers in the classroom. They can ask questions, work in groups and interact with classmates. On the other days, students can review lessons on an online platform. Teachers can upload videos, exercises and learning materials. Students can download documents and submit homework online. I think this learning method is flexible and useful. It gives students more time to review difficult lessons at their own speed. However, students need self-discipline because online learning can have many distractions. A good blended learning week should balance technology and real classroom communication. Thank you for listening.

Ví dụ, vào thứ Hai và thứ Tư, học sinh có thể học với giáo viên trong lớp. Các em có thể đặt câu hỏi, làm việc nhóm và tương tác với bạn cùng lớp. Vào những ngày khác, học sinh có thể ôn bài trên một nền tảng trực tuyến. Giáo viên có thể tải lên video, bài tập và tài liệu học tập. Học sinh có thể tải tài liệu xuống và nộp bài tập trực tuyến. Em nghĩ phương pháp học này linh hoạt và hữu ích. Nó cho học sinh thêm thời gian để ôn lại những bài khó theo tốc độ của riêng mình. Tuy nhiên, học sinh cần tính tự giác vì học trực tuyến có thể có nhiều sự xao nhãng. Một tuần học kết hợp tốt nên cân bằng giữa công nghệ và giao tiếp thật trong lớp học. Chúng ta cũng nên hiểu các vấn đề toàn cầu như nghèo đói, nạn đói, ô nhiễm và biến đổi khí hậu. Để trở thành công dân toàn cầu tốt, chúng ta cần kiến thức, lòng tốt và trách nhiệm. Một số học sinh có thể đại diện cho Việt Nam trong các cuộc thi, chương trình trao đổi hoặc dự án trực tuyến. Em tin rằng người trẻ Việt Nam có thể đóng góp cho cả đất nước và thế giới nếu chúng ta học tập chăm chỉ và sống có trách nhiệm. Cảm ơn cô và các bạn đã lắng nghe. lessons.title: Lesson 34: The United Nations and World Peace
lessons.topic: The United Nations and World Peace
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about the United Nations and world peace. The United Nations, or UN, is one of the most important international organisations in the world. It works to promote world peace, protect human rights and support development. Many countries cooperate through the UN to discuss global problems and find solutions. One important activity of the UN is peacekeeping. Peacekeeping missions help protect people in areas affected by conflict. Viet Nam has also joined some peacekeeping activities, which shows our responsibility in the global community. I think peace is very important because people cannot study, work or live happily without safety. The UN reminds us that countries should solve problems through cooperation, not violence. Thank you for listening.

Tổ chức này hoạt động để thúc đẩy hòa bình thế giới, bảo vệ nhân quyền và hỗ trợ phát triển. Nhiều quốc gia hợp tác thông qua Liên Hợp Quốc để thảo luận các vấn đề toàn cầu và tìm giải pháp. Một hoạt động quan trọng của Liên Hợp Quốc là gìn giữ hòa bình. Các nhiệm vụ gìn giữ hòa bình giúp bảo vệ con người ở những khu vực bị ảnh hưởng bởi xung đột. Việt Nam cũng đã tham gia một số hoạt động gìn giữ hòa bình, điều này thể hiện trách nhiệm của đất nước chúng ta trong cộng đồng toàn cầu. Em nghĩ hòa bình rất quan trọng vì con người không thể học tập, làm việc hoặc sống hạnh phúc nếu không có sự an toàn. Liên Hợp Quốc nhắc nhở chúng ta rằng các quốc gia nên giải quyết vấn đề bằng hợp tác, không phải bằng bạo lực. Cảm ơn cô và các bạn đã lắng nghe. lessons.title: Lesson 33: The WTO and International Trade
lessons.passage: Good morning, everyone. Today, I would like to talk about the WTO and international trade. The WTO, or World Trade Organization, is an international organisation that helps countries trade with one another. When countries join trade agreements, they can sell and buy goods more easily. For Viet Nam, international trade brings many opportunities. It can support economic growth, attract investors and create more jobs. Vietnamese products such as rice, coffee, seafood and clothes can reach many foreign markets. However, businesses also need to improve quality and follow international rules. I think students should know about trade because it affects the economy and people’s lives. International organisations like the WTO help countries cooperate and develop in a globalised world. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 32: UNICEF and Children’s Rights
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about UNICEF and children’s rights. UNICEF is an international organisation that works to protect children and improve their lives. It supports children’s rights, such as the right to education, health care, clean water and protection. In many places, children still face poverty, hunger and unsafe living conditions. UNICEF works with governments and communities to solve these problems. I think the work of UNICEF is very meaningful because children are the future of every country. Students can also learn from UNICEF’s activities. We should respect children’s rights, help disadvantaged children and take part in charity projects at school. Global issues may be big, but small actions from young people can still bring positive changes. Thank you for listening.

UNICEF hợp tác với chính phủ và cộng đồng để giải quyết những vấn đề này. Em nghĩ công việc của UNICEF rất ý nghĩa vì trẻ em là tương lai của mỗi quốc gia. lessons.title: Lesson 30: A School Campaign for Gender Equality
lessons.topic: A School Campaign for Gender Equality
lessons.passage: Good morning, teacher and friends. Today, I would like to introduce a school campaign for gender equality. The campaign is called “Equal Chances for Everyone”. Its purpose is to raise awareness among students about equal rights and equal opportunities. During the campaign, students can make posters, give short presentations and discuss gender stereotypes. Teachers can organise group activities where boys and girls share tasks fairly. For example, girls can lead a science project, and boys can prepare decorations or take care of younger students. These activities show that tasks should not be limited by gender. I think this campaign is suitable for schools because it helps students learn respect from an early age. A fair school can help build a fair society. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 29: A Female Role Model
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about a female role model. One famous example is Valentina Tereshkova, the first woman to travel into space. She was a cosmonaut and became an inspiration for many women and girls around the world. Her story shows that women can do difficult and important jobs if they have opportunities and determination. In Viet Nam, we also have many talented women in education, science, business and leadership. A female leader can inspire young girls to believe in themselves. I think students should learn about successful women because these stories help break gender stereotypes. Everyone, whether male or female, has the right to dream big and work hard for success. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 28: Equal Pay and Equal Respect
lessons.passage: Good morning, everyone. Today, I would like to talk about equal pay and equal respect. In the workplace, men and women should be treated fairly. If they do the same job and have the same ability, they should receive equal salary. Gender discrimination in employment is unfair because it can stop people from developing their talents. Companies should give workers equal opportunities for training, promotion and leadership. At the same time, workers should respect one another and judge people by their effort, not their gender. Although we are students now, we should learn about this issue because we will become workers in the future. A fair workplace is better for everyone. It helps people feel confident, valued and motivated. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 27: Boys Can Do Care Work
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about why boys can do care work. In the past, many people believed that caring jobs were only for women. For example, they thought nurses and kindergarten teachers should be women. However, this idea is unfair. Men can also be gentle, patient and responsible. A male nurse can take good care of patients, and a male kindergarten teacher can teach children with love and creativity. Career choice should be based on ability, interest and effort, not gender. Social roles have changed, and people should respect different choices. I believe boys should not feel embarrassed when they choose caring jobs. Equal rights mean everyone can follow the job they love. Thank you for listening.

A male nurse can take good care of patients, and a male kindergarten teacher can teach children with love and creativity.
Career choice should be based on ability, interest and effort, not gender.
Social roles have changed, and people should respect different choices.
I believe boys should not feel embarrassed when they choose caring jobs.
Equal rights mean everyone can follow the job they love.
Thank you for listening.

exercise.translation:
Xin chào tất cả mọi người. Hôm nay, em sẽ nói về lý do con trai có thể làm các công việc chăm sóc. Trong quá khứ, nhiều người tin rằng các công việc chăm sóc chỉ dành cho phụ nữ. Ví dụ, họ nghĩ y tá và giáo viên mầm non nên là phụ nữ. Tuy nhiên, quan điểm này không công bằng. Nam giới cũng có thể dịu dàng, kiên nhẫn và có trách nhiệm. Một y tá nam có thể chăm sóc bệnh nhân tốt, và một giáo viên mầm non nam có thể dạy trẻ em bằng tình yêu thương và sự sáng tạo. Lựa chọn nghề nghiệp nên dựa trên năng lực, sở thích và sự nỗ lực, chứ không phải giới tính. Vai trò xã hội đã thay đổi, và mọi người nên tôn trọng những lựa chọn khác nhau. Em tin rằng con trai không nên cảm thấy xấu hổ khi chọn các công việc chăm sóc. Quyền bình đẳng có nghĩa là mọi người có thể theo đuổi công việc mình yêu thích. Cảm ơn cô và các bạn đã lắng nghe. lessons.title: Lesson 26: Girls in Science and Technology
lessons.passage: Good morning, teacher and friends. Today, I would like to talk about girls in science and technology. Some people still think that boys are better at science, maths and technology. This is a gender stereotype, and it is not fair. Girls can be talented in these subjects if they have equal opportunities and encouragement. At school, teachers should promote gender equality by giving both boys and girls chances to join science clubs, competitions and projects. Families should also support daughters who love technology or engineering. When girls receive good education, they can become scientists, engineers, doctors or inventors. I believe talent does not depend on gender. Every student should be free to follow their interests and dreams. Thank you for listening.

Khi các bạn nữ được giáo dục tốt, họ có thể trở thành nhà khoa học, kỹ sư, bác sĩ hoặc nhà phát minh. Em tin rằng tài năng không phụ thuộc vào giới tính. lessons.title: Lesson 25: Using Technology Responsibly
lessons.passage: Good morning, teacher and friends. Today, I would like to talk about using technology responsibly. Technology brings many advantages to students. Smartphones, laptops and artificial intelligence can help us search for information, learn languages and prepare presentations. However, technology also has disadvantages. Some students spend too much time on games, social media or short videos. They may depend on technology and forget to think by themselves. To use technology responsibly, we should set clear study goals and limit entertainment time. We should check information carefully before using it. We should also use AI as a support tool, not as a way to copy answers. In my opinion, technology is helpful only when people use it wisely. Thank you for listening.

Điện thoại thông minh, máy tính xách tay và trí tuệ nhân tạo có thể giúp chúng ta tìm kiếm thông tin, học ngôn ngữ và chuẩn bị bài thuyết trình. Tuy nhiên, công nghệ cũng có những bất lợi. Một số học sinh dành quá nhiều thời gian cho trò chơi, mạng xã hội hoặc video ngắn. Các em có thể phụ thuộc vào công nghệ và quên tự suy nghĩ. Để sử dụng công nghệ có trách nhiệm, chúng ta nên đặt mục tiêu học tập rõ ràng và giới hạn thời gian giải trí. Chúng ta nên kiểm tra thông tin cẩn thận trước khi sử dụng. Chúng ta cũng nên dùng AI như một công cụ hỗ trợ, không phải là cách để sao chép đáp án. Theo em, công nghệ chỉ hữu ích khi con người sử dụng nó một cách khôn ngoan. lessons.title: Lesson 24: Inventions for People with Disabilities
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about inventions for people with disabilities. These inventions are very meaningful because they help people live more independently. For example, wheelchairs help people move around more easily. Hearing aids support people who have hearing problems. Modern technology can also create smart devices that read text aloud or help people control computers by voice. Inventors who make these products do not only discover new technology. They also solve real problems in people’s lives. I think society should support inventions that improve life for people with disabilities. Students can also learn from this idea: technology should be used to help people and make the world kinder. Thank you for listening.

Ví dụ, xe lăn giúp người gặp khó khăn trong di chuyển đi lại dễ dàng hơn. Máy trợ thính hỗ trợ những người có vấn đề về thính giác. Em nghĩ xã hội nên ủng hộ những phát minh cải thiện cuộc sống cho người khuyết tật. lessons.title: Lesson 23: A Learning App for Vietnamese Students
lessons.topic: A Learning App for Vietnamese Students
lessons.passage: Good morning, everyone. Today, I would like to introduce a learning app for Vietnamese students. This app would be user-friendly and suitable for high school learners. It would have vocabulary lessons, grammar exercises, pronunciation practice and short tests. One useful function would be instant feedback. After students finish an exercise, the app would show mistakes and explain the answers. Students could use the app on a smartphone, tablet or laptop, so it would be portable and convenient. The app could also remind students to review old lessons every day. I think good educational software should not make students lazy. It should help them practise more effectively. With the right app, students can learn English anytime and anywhere. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 22: Robots in Daily Life
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about robots in daily life. Robots are useful inventions because they can do many tasks for people. In factories, some robots can replace human workers in dangerous or repetitive jobs. At home, robot vacuum cleaners can clean the floor automatically and save time. In hospitals, robots can support doctors and nurses in some tasks. Robots have many advantages, but they also have disadvantages. If people depend too much on robots, they may become less active. Some workers may also worry about losing their jobs. In my opinion, robots should support humans, not completely replace humans. We need to use technology wisely and responsibly. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 21: A Smart Home
lessons.passage: Good morning, teacher and friends. Today, I would like to talk about a smart home. A smart home is a house that uses modern technology to make life more convenient. In a smart home, many devices can work automatically. For example, lights can turn on when people enter a room and turn off when nobody is there. An air conditioner can adjust the temperature, and a smart camera can help protect the house. A smart home can also be energy-saving because it reduces unnecessary electricity use. I think this invention is useful for busy families in modern cities. However, people should learn how to use smart devices safely and protect their personal information. A good invention should make life easier and safer. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 20: What I Learn from Volunteering
lessons.passage: Good morning, teacher and friends. Today, I would like to talk about what I learn from volunteering. Volunteer work is not only about helping other people. It also helps students learn many important lessons. First, I learn kindness. When I meet people in difficult situations, I understand that everyone needs care and respect. Second, I learn teamwork. In a volunteer project, members need to plan, divide tasks and support one another. Third, I improve my communication skills because I have to talk to different people politely and clearly. Teachers should encourage students to volunteer because these activities make school life more meaningful. In my opinion, volunteering helps young people become more mature, responsible and caring. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 19: A Clean-up Day in My Community
lessons.topic: A Clean-up Day in My Community
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about a clean-up day in my community. A clean-up day is a practical volunteer activity that students can take part in. In this activity, students, teachers and local people work together to clean public places such as streets, parks and school areas. Before the event, we can prepare gloves, rubbish bags and posters. During the event, we collect litter and sort recyclable waste. After that, we can put up posters to remind people to keep the area clean. I think this activity supports community development because it makes the living environment better. It also raises awareness about public responsibility. When many people work together, they can make a real difference. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 18: A Book Donation Project
lessons.passage: Good morning, everyone. Today, I would like to introduce a book donation project. The project is called “Books for Bright Futures”. Its purpose is to collect books for disadvantaged children and children in orphanages. Each student can donate old textbooks, storybooks or notebooks that are still in good condition. We can organise the books by age and subject before sending them to children. Participants can also write short encouraging messages inside the books. This project does not require a lot of money, but it can bring great value. Books give children knowledge, joy and hope. The project can also raise awareness among students about sharing and helping others. I believe a small book can open a big dream. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 17: Helping Homeless People
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about helping homeless people. In some cities, there are people who do not have a safe home or stable living conditions. They may sleep on the street and lack food, warm clothes or medical care. To support them, students can join a charity campaign. We can donate old clothes, blankets, instant noodles and other useful things. We can also raise money to buy meals for people in need. Of course, we should do these activities with guidance from teachers and parents to make sure everything is safe and respectful. Helping homeless people is a meaningful action. It teaches us kindness and reminds us to be grateful for what we have. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 16: Applying for Volunteer Work
lessons.passage: Good morning, teacher and friends. Today, I would like to talk about applying for volunteer work. Last week, I saw an advertisement for student volunteers at a local centre. The centre needed students to help children with reading and simple English. I think this is a good chance for teenagers to get involved in community service. If I apply for this work, I will write a short application and explain why I want to volunteer. I will say that I am patient, responsible and willing to help. Volunteer work like this is practical because it supports children and also helps students improve communication skills. In my opinion, teenagers should not wait until they are adults to help the community. We can start with small actions now. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 15: Protecting Traditional Music
lessons.passage: Good morning, teacher and friends. Today, I would like to talk about protecting traditional music. Traditional music is an important part of Vietnamese culture. It shows the feelings, history and lifestyle of Vietnamese people. However, many young people today listen mainly to modern music and know little about traditional forms. To protect traditional music, schools can organise performances and introduce famous composers or artists. Students can also listen to folk songs, learn about traditional instruments and share short presentations in class. Modern musicians may release new songs that combine traditional sounds with modern styles. This can make traditional music closer to young listeners. I believe protecting traditional music means protecting our national identity. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 13: Learning a Musical Instrument
lessons.passage: Good morning, everyone. Today, I would like to talk about learning a musical instrument. Many students choose to learn the guitar, piano, drum or violin. Playing a musical instrument is not easy at first because we need to practise regularly. We also need to understand rhythm and melody. However, this activity has many benefits. It helps students become more patient and confident. When students perform in front of others, they learn how to control their feelings and express themselves. Learning an instrument can also inspire students to love music more deeply. Some students may even dream of becoming musicians in the future. In my opinion, every student should try learning an instrument if they have a chance. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 12: A Music Talent Show
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about a music talent show. A talent show is an exciting activity because it gives students a chance to show their abilities. In a music talent show, contestants can sing, play musical instruments or compose their own songs. The judges should give fair comments and encourage students to improve. Some contestants may be eliminated after each round, but they can still learn useful lessons from the experience. At the end of the show, the best performer can receive an award. I think a school talent show should not only focus on winning. It should help students become more confident and creative. It is also a good way for the audience to enjoy music together. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 11: A Vietnamese Music Festival
lessons.passage: Good morning, teacher and friends. Today, I would like to talk about a Vietnamese music festival. A music festival is a great chance for people to enjoy different kinds of music. In a Vietnamese music festival, artists can perform folk songs, traditional music and modern songs. The audience can learn about Vietnamese culture through melodies, lyrics and musical instruments. I think a school music festival would be very meaningful. Students could sing quan họ, perform folk dances or play simple instruments. Some students could introduce the history of each song before the performance. This activity would help young people feel proud of their culture. Music is not only entertainment. It is also a bridge between generations. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 10: My Family’s Green Lifestyle
lessons.passage: Good morning, teacher and friends. Today, I would like to talk about my family’s green lifestyle. My family is not perfect, but we try to live in an environmentally friendly way. We reuse glass bottles and old boxes. We recycle paper and plastic when possible. When we go shopping, we bring reusable bags instead of taking plastic bags from shops. For short distances, we often walk or ride bicycles. If we go farther, we try to use public transport. These habits help us reduce our carbon footprint. I believe a green lifestyle should not be something difficult or expensive. It can begin with daily habits in each family. If more families live green, our community will become cleaner and healthier. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 9: Reducing Electricity Bills at Home
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about reducing electricity bills at home. Saving electricity is good for both our family and the environment. When we use less electricity, our family can spend less money on electricity bills. We can also reduce our carbon footprint. There are many easy ways to save electricity. We should turn off lights, fans, televisions and other household appliances when we do not use them. We can use energy-saving bulbs and choose energy-saving appliances. In summer, we should set the air conditioner at a suitable temperature and use fans when possible. I think every family should adopt these habits. Going green at home can begin with saving electricity every day. Thank you for listening.

Khi dùng ít điện hơn, gia đình chúng ta có thể chi ít tiền hơn cho hóa đơn tiền điện. Chúng ta cũng có thể giảm dấu chân carbon của mình. Có nhiều cách dễ dàng để tiết kiệm điện. lessons.title: Lesson 8: Saving Water in Daily Life
lessons.passage: Good morning, everyone. Today, I would like to talk about saving water in daily life. Water is a precious natural resource, but many people still waste it. In some places, water shortage has become a serious problem, especially during hot seasons. At home, we can save water in many simple ways. We should turn off the tap while brushing our teeth. We should use enough water when washing dishes and taking a shower. We can also reuse water from washing vegetables to water plants. At school, students should report broken taps and remind friends not to waste water. Saving water is not difficult, but it needs awareness and daily practice. If we save water today, future generations will have a better life. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 7: Eco-friendly Shopping Habits
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about eco-friendly shopping habits. Shopping is a normal activity, but the way we shop can affect the environment. Many people use single-use plastic bags, plastic cups and too much packaging. These products are harmful to the environment because they are difficult to break down. To shop in a greener way, we can bring cloth bags to the market or supermarket. We can choose products with less packaging and buy organic food when possible. We should also cut down on unnecessary things, because producing too many goods uses energy and natural resources. I think eco-friendly shopping is suitable for Vietnamese families because it is simple and practical. Small changes in shopping habits can help protect the environment. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 6: A Green Classroom
lessons.passage: Good morning, teacher and friends. Today, I would like to talk about building a green classroom. A green classroom is a place where students learn and also practise protecting the environment. In my class, we can start with simple habits. We should turn off lights and fans when we leave the room. We can reuse paper for notes and recycle old worksheets. We can also place small bins for paper, plastic and food waste to sort rubbish properly. Another good idea is to make posters about saving energy and reducing plastic waste. These posters can raise students’ awareness every day. I think a green classroom does not require a lot of money. It requires good habits, teamwork and responsibility. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 5: A Weekend Family Plan
lessons.passage: Good morning, teacher and friends. Today, I am going to present a weekend family plan. At weekends, my family usually tries to spend more time together because weekdays are very busy. On Saturday morning, we clean the house and buy groceries at the local market. Then we prepare lunch together. My mother cooks the main dishes, my father washes vegetables, and I set the table. In the afternoon, we may visit our grandparents or go for a walk. On Sunday evening, we talk about our plans for the new week. I think this routine is simple but meaningful. It helps strengthen our family bond and teaches children how to support others. I feel lucky to grow up in a caring family. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 4: Teenagers and Life Skills at Home
lessons.topic: Teenagers and Life Skills at Home
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I would like to talk about teenagers and life skills at home. Many students think they only need to study well, but I believe teenagers should also learn basic life skills. At home, we can learn how to cook simple dishes, tidy up our rooms, prepare school things and look after younger brothers or sisters. These tasks are not too difficult, but they are very useful. They help us become more independent and responsible. When we go to university or live far from home in the future, these skills will help us take care of ourselves. Doing housework is not a waste of time. It is a practical way to learn important lessons for real life. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 3: Showing Gratitude to Parents
lessons.passage: Good morning, everyone. Today, I would like to talk about showing gratitude to parents. Parents do many things for their children every day. They earn money, prepare meals, take care of the family and worry about our future. In many Vietnamese families, parents do not always say they are tired, but they work very hard. As students, we can show gratitude through simple actions. We can study seriously, help with housework, speak politely and respect our parents’ advice. We can also say “thank you” more often. I believe gratitude helps build good character. When we understand our parents’ effort, we become more caring and responsible. For me, helping my parents is a small but meaningful way to show love. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 2: Dividing Household Chores Fairly
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today, I am going to talk about dividing household chores fairly. In some families, one person has to do most of the housework. I think this is not fair because every family member lives in the same home and should have responsibilities. At my house, we divide tasks according to age and ability. My father often does the heavy lifting and repairs things. My mother cooks many meals, but she is not the only homemaker. I do the washing-up, tidy my room and sometimes buy groceries. My younger sister folds clothes and helps with simple cleaning. When chores are shared fairly, everyone feels less tired. More importantly, children learn life skills and become more independent. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 1: Family Communication
lessons.passage: Good morning, teacher and friends. Today, I would like to talk about family communication. In modern life, many parents and teenagers are busy, so they sometimes do not have enough time to talk. However, communication is very important because it helps strengthen the family bond. In my family, we often talk during dinner. We share good news, school problems and plans for the next day. When I feel stressed, my parents listen to me and cheer me up. I also try to listen to their advice with respect. I think a happy family is not a perfect family. It is a family where people support one another and solve problems together. Good communication makes family life warmer and more meaningful. Thank you for listening.

lessons.title: Lesson 80: My Dream Summer Holiday
lessons.passage: Good morning. My dream summer holiday is a trip to a beautiful island with my family. We can swim in the sea, build sandcastles, and eat fresh fruit. I also want to go on a short camping trip and watch the stars at night. During the day, we can take photos and explore new places. I think this holiday would be exciting and unforgettable. I hope it will come true one day.

exercise.title: Lesson 80: My Dream Summer Holiday

sentences.text: Good morning.
My dream summer holiday is a trip to a beautiful island with my family.
We can swim in the sea, build sandcastles, and eat fresh fruit.
I also want to go on a short camping trip and watch the stars at night.
During the day, we can take photos and explore new places.
I think this holiday would be exciting and unforgettable.
I hope it will come true one day.

exercise.translation: Chào buổi sáng. Kỳ nghỉ hè mơ ước của em là một chuyến đi đến một hòn đảo xinh đẹp cùng gia đình. Chúng em có thể bơi ở biển, xây lâu đài cát và ăn trái cây tươi. Em cũng muốn đi cắm trại ngắn ngày và ngắm các vì sao vào ban đêm. Ban ngày, chúng em có thể chụp ảnh và khám phá những nơi mới. Em nghĩ kỳ nghỉ này sẽ rất thú vị và khó quên. Em hy vọng nó sẽ trở thành hiện thực một ngày nào đó.

lessons.title: Lesson 79: My Summer Learning Plan
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Summer is a time to relax, but it is also a good time to learn. This summer, I plan to read more books and practise English every day. I also want to join a swimming class and a drawing club. These activities will help me improve my skills. I will still have time to rest and play with my friends. I think a good summer plan should have both study and fun.

exercise.translation:
Xin chào mọi người. Mùa hè là thời gian để thư giãn, nhưng cũng là thời gian tốt để học. Mùa hè này, em dự định đọc thêm sách và luyện tiếng Anh mỗi ngày. Em cũng muốn tham gia một lớp học bơi và một câu lạc bộ vẽ. Những hoạt động này sẽ giúp em cải thiện kỹ năng. Em vẫn sẽ có thời gian nghỉ ngơi và chơi với bạn bè. Em nghĩ một kế hoạch mùa hè tốt nên có cả học tập và vui chơi. UNIT 20 • LESSON 80: My Dream Summer Holiday
ENGLISH DICTATION PRACTICE • IMPORT READY

lessons.title: Lesson 78: Staying with My Grandparents
lessons.passage: Good morning. One summer holiday, I stayed with my grandparents in the countryside. Their house is simple, but it is very peaceful. Every morning, I helped feed the chickens and water the plants. In the afternoon, I played outside and ate fresh fruit from the garden. My grandparents told me many interesting stories. That holiday was quiet, useful, and full of love.

Chào buổi sáng. Có một kỳ nghỉ hè em ở với ông bà ở nông thôn. Ngôi nhà của ông bà đơn giản nhưng rất yên bình. Mỗi sáng, em giúp cho gà ăn và tưới cây. Buổi chiều, em chơi bên ngoài và ăn trái cây tươi trong vườn. Ông bà kể cho em nghe nhiều câu chuyện thú vị. Kỳ nghỉ đó yên tĩnh, hữu ích và đầy tình yêu thương. ENGLISH DICTATION PRACTICE • IMPORT READY

lessons.title: Lesson 77: A Summer Holiday at the Beach
lessons.topic: A Summer Holiday at the Beach
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Last summer, my family went to Da Nang for our summer holiday. We stayed in a small hotel near the beach. In the morning, we swam in the sea and played with sand. In the afternoon, we visited some interesting places and ate delicious seafood. In the evening, we walked by the beach and watched the sunset. It was a happy and relaxing holiday.

Buổi chiều, chúng em đến thăm một số địa điểm thú vị và ăn hải sản ngon. Buổi tối, chúng em đi bộ dọc bãi biển và ngắm hoàng hôn. Đó là một kỳ nghỉ vui vẻ và thư giãn. ENGLISH DICTATION PRACTICE • IMPORT READY

lessons.title: Lesson 76: My Dream Place to Visit
lessons.passage: Good morning. There are many places of interest that I want to visit. My dream place is Hoi An Ancient Town. I want to see the old houses, colourful lanterns, and quiet streets. I also want to try local food and take many photos. Visiting new places helps us discover culture and beauty. I hope my family and I can go there one day.

Em muốn nhìn thấy những ngôi nhà cổ, những chiếc đèn lồng nhiều màu sắc và những con phố yên tĩnh. Em cũng muốn thử các món ăn địa phương và chụp nhiều ảnh. Thăm những nơi mới giúp chúng ta khám phá văn hóa và vẻ đẹp. Em hy vọng gia đình em và em có thể đến đó một ngày nào đó. UNIT 20 • LESSON 77: A Summer Holiday at the Beach
ENGLISH DICTATION PRACTICE • IMPORT READY

lessons.title: Lesson 75: Visiting a Museum
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. A museum is a very interesting place to visit. In a museum, we can see old objects, paintings, and many useful exhibits. Some museums teach us about history, and others show art or science. When I visit a museum, I always learn something new. I listen carefully to the guide and look at everything with interest. Museums are both fun and educational.

lessons.title: Lesson 74: A Place I Like in My City
lessons.topic: A Place I Like in My City
lessons.passage: Good morning. In my city, there is a park that many people like to visit. It has many trees, flowers, and a small lake. Families often go there in the morning or late afternoon. Children can play, and adults can walk or exercise. I enjoy this place because it is peaceful and near my home. It is one of my favourite places in the city.

Trẻ em có thể chơi, còn người lớn có thể đi bộ hoặc tập thể dục. Em thích nơi này vì nó yên bình và gần nhà. Đây là một trong những địa điểm yêu thích của em trong thành phố. lessons.title: Lesson 73: Ha Long Bay
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. One famous place of interest in Viet Nam is Ha Long Bay. It has many beautiful islands in the sea. People can travel by boat and visit amazing caves. The water is blue, and the scenery is wonderful. Many tourists visit this place every year. I hope I can go there again with my family because it is very beautiful.

Nước biển màu xanh và phong cảnh rất tuyệt vời. Nhiều khách du lịch đến đây mỗi năm. Em hy vọng có thể trở lại đó cùng gia đình vì nơi này rất đẹp. UNIT 19 • LESSON 74: A Place I Like in My City

lessons.title: Lesson 72: My Favourite Means of Transport
lessons.passage: Good morning. My favourite means of transport is the aeroplane. It is fast and can take people to far places in a short time. I like looking out of the window and seeing the clouds. Going to the airport is also exciting for me. Although I do not travel by plane often, I think it is an interesting way to travel. I hope to have more plane journeys in the future.

Đi đến sân bay cũng khiến em cảm thấy thú vị. Mặc dù em không thường xuyên đi máy bay, em nghĩ đây là một cách di chuyển rất thú vị. Em hy vọng sẽ có nhiều chuyến bay hơn trong tương lai. lessons.title: Lesson 71: Public Transport in the City
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. In big cities, many people use public transport. Buses and trains carry many passengers every day. They are convenient and can help reduce traffic jams. Public transport is also better for the environment because it can reduce air pollution. If I live in a big city one day, I would like to travel by bus or train more often.

Giao thông công cộng cũng tốt hơn cho môi trường vì có thể giảm ô nhiễm không khí. Nếu một ngày nào đó sống ở thành phố lớn, em muốn đi xe buýt hoặc tàu hỏa thường xuyên hơn. lessons.title: Lesson 70: Safe Traffic Habits
lessons.passage: Good morning. Today I want to talk about safe traffic habits. When we walk on the road, we should use the pavement if there is one. We should cross the road at the zebra crossing and wait for the green light. When we ride a bike or sit on a motorbike, we need to be careful. Following traffic rules keeps us safe every day.

Chúng ta nên sang đường ở vạch sang đường dành cho người đi bộ và chờ đèn xanh. Khi đi xe đạp hoặc ngồi trên xe máy, chúng ta cần cẩn thận. Tuân thủ luật giao thông giúp chúng ta an toàn mỗi ngày. UNIT 18 • LESSON 71: Public Transport in the City
ENGLISH DICTATION PRACTICE • IMPORT READY

lessons.title: Lesson 69: How I Go to School
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. I would like to talk about how I go to school. My school is not far from my home, so I usually go by bike. My father rides with me in the morning when the road is busy. On rainy days, he takes me by motorbike. Going to school safely is very important. We always follow the traffic rules and wear helmets when needed.

Đi học an toàn rất quan trọng. Chúng em luôn tuân thủ luật giao thông và đội mũ bảo hiểm khi cần thiết. UNIT 18 • LESSON 70: Safe Traffic Habits
ENGLISH DICTATION PRACTICE • IMPORT READY

lessons.title: Lesson 68: Making Up My Own Story
lessons.passage: Good morning. Sometimes I like making up my own stories. I imagine a small rabbit living in a green forest. One day, the rabbit goes on an adventure to find a lost basket. On the way, it meets new friends and helps them. In the end, the rabbit finds the basket and returns home safely. Creating stories is fun because it helps me be creative and think freely.

Một ngày nọ, chú thỏ bắt đầu một cuộc phiêu lưu để tìm một chiếc giỏ bị mất. Trên đường đi, nó gặp những người bạn mới và giúp đỡ họ. Cuối cùng, chú thỏ tìm thấy chiếc giỏ và trở về nhà an toàn. Sáng tạo câu chuyện thật vui vì nó giúp em sáng tạo và suy nghĩ tự do. UNIT 18 • LESSON 69: How I Go to School
ENGLISH DICTATION PRACTICE • IMPORT READY

lessons.title: Lesson 67: A Character I Like
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. In many children’s stories, there are interesting characters. The character I like most is a clever and helpful boy in a fairy tale. He is not rich or strong, but he uses his mind to solve problems. He also helps other people when they are in trouble. I admire him because he is kind and brave. Good characters teach us good values.

Cậu ấy không giàu cũng không khỏe, nhưng cậu sử dụng trí óc để giải quyết vấn đề. Cậu cũng giúp những người khác khi họ gặp khó khăn. Em ngưỡng mộ cậu vì cậu tốt bụng và dũng cảm. lessons.title: Lesson 66: Reading Stories with My Family
lessons.passage: Good morning. I enjoy reading stories with my family. In the evening, my mother sometimes reads a story aloud to me and my sister. We look at the pictures and talk about the characters. After that, I try to read some pages by myself. Reading stories helps me learn new words and use my imagination. It is also a lovely family activity.

Sau đó, em cố gắng tự đọc một vài trang. Đọc truyện giúp em học từ mới và sử dụng trí tưởng tượng. Đây cũng là một hoạt động gia đình rất đáng yêu. UNIT 17 • LESSON 67: A Character I Like
ENGLISH DICTATION PRACTICE • IMPORT READY

lessons.title: Lesson 65: My Favourite Story
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. My favourite story is The Tortoise and the Hare. It is about a race between a slow tortoise and a fast hare. The hare is proud and careless, but the tortoise is patient and steady. In the end, the tortoise wins the race. I like this story because it is simple and meaningful. It teaches us that slow and careful work can bring success.

lessons.title: Lesson 64: Today’s Weather Report
lessons.passage: Good morning. Here is a short weather report for today. This morning, the weather is cloudy and a little windy. The temperature is not too high, so it feels quite comfortable. In the afternoon, there may be light rain, so we should bring a small umbrella. If we go out, we should wear a light jacket. Knowing the weather forecast helps us prepare well for the day.

lessons.title: Lesson 63: Summer Weather and Activities
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Summer is the hottest season of the year. On hot days, I drink more water and wear light clothes. During the summer holiday, I like going swimming or visiting the beach with my family. We can also eat cold fruit and ice cream. Although summer is hot, it is fun because we have more time to play and travel.

lessons.title: Lesson 62: A Rainy Day
lessons.passage: Good morning. I want to talk about a rainy day. When the weather is rainy, I take an umbrella or wear a raincoat to school. The roads can be wet, so we need to be careful. At home, I like sitting by the window, reading a storybook, and listening to the sound of the rain. Rainy days are quiet and peaceful for me.

lessons.title: Lesson 61: My Favourite Season
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. My favourite season is spring. The weather is warm and pleasant. There are many beautiful flowers, and the trees become green again. In spring, my family sometimes goes for a walk or has a picnic in the park. I like this season because it is fresh and full of life. Spring always makes me feel happy and relaxed.

lessons.title: Lesson 60: Taking Care of My Eyes
lessons.passage: Good morning. Today I want to talk about taking care of our eyes. Many children spend a lot of time looking at screens. To protect our eyes, we should not watch TV or use phones for too long. We should read in a bright place and keep a safe distance from books and screens. Looking at green trees and resting our eyes are also helpful. Healthy eyes are very important for learning.

Chúng ta nên đọc sách ở nơi đủ sáng và giữ khoảng cách an toàn với sách và màn hình. Nhìn cây xanh và cho mắt nghỉ ngơi cũng rất có ích. Đôi mắt khỏe mạnh rất quan trọng cho việc học tập. lessons.title: Lesson 59: Advice for Good Health
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. There are many ways to keep our health in good condition. We should eat healthy food, exercise regularly, and get enough sleep. We also need to drink water and have regular check-ups when necessary. We should avoid too many soft drinks and too much screen time. If we follow these simple rules, we can grow well and stay strong.

lessons.title: Lesson 58: A Visit to the Dentist
lessons.passage: Good morning. Last month, I visited the dentist because I had a toothache. The dentist looked at my teeth and cleaned them carefully. She told me to brush my teeth twice a day and eat fewer sweets. At first, I felt nervous, but the dentist was kind and gentle. Now I know that visiting the dentist is important for good health.

Ban đầu em cảm thấy lo lắng, nhưng nha sĩ rất tử tế và nhẹ nhàng. Bây giờ em biết rằng đi khám nha sĩ rất quan trọng để có sức khỏe tốt. UNIT 15 • LESSON 59: Advice for Good Health

lessons.title: Lesson 57: When I Feel Ill
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Sometimes we do not feel well, and we need to take care of our health. When I have a headache or a fever, I tell my parents at once. I drink warm water, rest in bed, and take medicine if the doctor says so. I do not go to school when I am very sick. After a good rest, I feel better and recover quickly.

Em uống nước ấm, nghỉ ngơi trên giường và uống thuốc nếu bác sĩ chỉ định. Em không đi học khi bị ốm nặng. Sau khi nghỉ ngơi đầy đủ, em cảm thấy khá hơn và hồi phục nhanh chóng. lessons.title: Lesson 56: Keeping Clean to Stay Healthy
lessons.passage: Good morning. Keeping clean is a simple way to stay healthy. We should wash our hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet. We should take a bath regularly and wear clean clothes. It is also important to brush our teeth in the morning and before bed. Clean habits help keep germs away. When we are clean, we are more comfortable and healthier.

Việc đánh răng vào buổi sáng và trước khi đi ngủ cũng rất quan trọng. Những thói quen sạch sẽ giúp ngăn vi khuẩn tránh xa. Khi sạch sẽ, chúng ta cảm thấy thoải mái và khỏe mạnh hơn. lessons.title: Lesson 55: Exercise Is Important
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Exercise is very important for our health. We do not need to do difficult sports every day. We can walk, run, skip rope, or play badminton. Exercise makes our bodies stronger and helps our hearts work well. It also helps us feel happier and less tired. I think every student should make exercise a healthy habit.

Tập thể dục làm cơ thể khỏe hơn và giúp tim hoạt động tốt. Nó cũng giúp chúng ta cảm thấy vui vẻ và bớt mệt mỏi. Em nghĩ mỗi học sinh nên biến việc tập thể dục thành một thói quen lành mạnh. lessons.title: Lesson 54: A Healthy Lunchbox
lessons.passage: Good morning. Today I want to talk about a healthy lunchbox. A good lunchbox should have different kinds of food. I like rice with chicken or fish, some vegetables, and a piece of fruit. I also bring water instead of too many sweet drinks. I do not eat a lot of sweets or fried food. Choosing balanced food helps me study and play better.

Em cũng mang theo nước thay vì uống quá nhiều đồ uống ngọt. Em không ăn nhiều đồ ngọt hoặc đồ chiên. Chọn thức ăn cân bằng giúp em học tập và vui chơi tốt hơn. lessons.title: Lesson 53: My Healthy Daily Routine
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. I try to follow a healthy daily routine. I get up early, brush my teeth, and eat breakfast before school. At school, I drink enough water and wash my hands before lunch. In the afternoon, I exercise or play badminton. In the evening, I do my homework and go to bed on time. These habits help me stay active and healthy.

Buổi chiều, em tập thể dục hoặc chơi cầu lông. Buổi tối, em làm bài tập và đi ngủ đúng giờ. Những thói quen này giúp em năng động và khỏe mạnh. UNIT 14 • LESSON 54: A Healthy Lunchbox

lessons.title: Lesson 52: International Children’s Day
lessons.passage: Good morning. International Children’s Day is on the first of June. On this day, many children receive small gifts from their parents. Some schools or local centres organise performances and games. Sometimes my family takes me to the park or out for a nice meal. I like this day because it celebrates children and brings many smiles. It is a happy and exciting special day.

lessons.title: Lesson 51: My Birthday Party
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. I would like to talk about my birthday party. Last year, I invited some close friends to my home. My mother made a cake, and my father decorated the room with balloons. We played simple games, sang songs, and ate fruit and snacks. I was happy to receive some lovely presents. More importantly, I enjoyed the laughter and time with my friends. It was a memorable day.

lessons.title: Lesson 50: The Mid-Autumn Festival
lessons.passage: Good morning. The Mid-Autumn Festival is one of my favourite special days. It usually comes in autumn when the moon is bright and round. Children carry colourful lanterns, watch lion dances, and eat mooncakes. In my neighbourhood, we gather in the evening to sing songs and play games. My favourite part is walking with my friends under the lantern lights. It is a joyful festival for children.

lessons.title: Lesson 49: Vietnamese Teachers’ Day
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Vietnamese Teachers’ Day is on the twentieth of November. It is a special day for pupils to thank their teachers. At my school, we decorate the classroom and make handmade cards. Some pupils sing songs, dance, or give short speeches. I like writing a kind message to my teacher because she helps me learn every day. This day reminds us to respect our teachers.

lessons.title: Lesson 48: My Favourite Tet Activity
lessons.passage: Good morning. My favourite Tet activity is meeting my cousins. We wear colourful clothes, play games, and look at the red decorations in the house. Sometimes we help adults prepare food or arrange fruit on the table. I also like receiving lucky money and keeping it in a small envelope box. Tet is joyful because children can play and families can be together. That is why I love this holiday so much.

lessons.title: Lesson 47: Visiting Grandparents at Tet
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. During Tet, visiting my grandparents is very special. We bring fruit and some small gifts to their house. I greet them politely and give them my best wishes. Then we sit together, drink tea, and listen to stories about old Tet holidays. My grandparents are always happy to see the whole family. These visits make Tet warmer and more meaningful for me.

lessons.title: Lesson 46: My First Day of Tet
lessons.passage: Good morning. On the first day of Tet, I get up early and wear new clothes. My family gives good wishes to my grandparents. We eat traditional food and talk happily together. I receive lucky money and say thank you politely. Later, we visit some relatives and neighbours. For me, Tet is a time for love, respect, and hope for a new year.

lessons.title: Lesson 44: A Family Birthday Celebration
lessons.passage: Good morning. I would like to talk about a family birthday celebration. On my mother’s birthday, we usually buy a small cake and some flowers. In the evening, we eat dinner together and sing a birthday song. I often make a handmade card or give her a small gift. We take photos and enjoy a happy time together. Family celebrations do not need to be big to be meaningful.

lessons.title: Lesson 43: Helping with Housework
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. I think children should help with housework. At home, I sweep the floor, fold my clothes, and water the plants. lessons.title: Lesson 40: Our Class Trip to the Zoo
lessons.topic: Our Class Trip to the Zoo
lessons.passage: Good morning. One of the happiest school trips was our class trip to the zoo. We saw elephants, monkeys, tigers, and many birds. My favourite animal was the giraffe because it was tall and gentle. We listened to the teacher and walked in groups. We took some photos and talked about how to protect animals. The zoo trip helped us learn about wildlife in a fun way.

The museum trip was both exciting and educational.

The playground is a fun place to use our energy and make new friends.

lessons.passage: Good morning. Another school activity I enjoy is art time. In the art room, we draw pictures, colour them, and make simple crafts. Sometimes we paint flowers, animals, or our dream houses. I like art because I can be creative and use many colours. When we finish, the teacher often displays our work on the wall. Looking at our pictures makes the classroom more beautiful. Art time is fun and relaxing for me.

Đôi khi chúng em vẽ hoa, động vật hoặc những ngôi nhà mơ ước. Em thích mỹ thuật vì em có thể sáng tạo và sử dụng nhiều màu sắc. Khi hoàn thành, giáo viên thường trưng bày sản phẩm của chúng em trên tường. Nhìn những bức tranh khiến lớp học đẹp hơn. Giờ mỹ thuật thật vui và thư giãn đối với em. lessons.title: Lesson 27: Sports Day at School
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. One of my favourite school activities is Sports Day. Before the event, we practise running, jumping, and team games. On that day, the playground is full of energy and happy voices. Some pupils join races, and others cheer for their teams. I like relay races because we need to work together. Sports Day helps us stay active and learn teamwork. It is always exciting and memorable.

lessons.title: Lesson 26: Our Reading Club
lessons.passage: Good morning. I would like to talk about our school reading club. We meet in the library every Friday afternoon. Each week, one pupil chooses a short story and tells the group about it. Sometimes we read aloud or act out a scene. After that, we talk about our favourite character. I enjoy the club because I can discover new books and learn new words. Reading together also makes me braver when I speak.

lessons.title: Lesson 25: My Favourite School Activity
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. My favourite school activity is doing group projects. In a project, my classmates and I share ideas and work together. Last month, we made a poster about protecting the environment. I wrote short sentences, and my friend drew pictures. Then we presented our work to the class. Group projects help us learn, communicate, and become more confident. I always feel proud when our team does well.

Tháng trước, chúng em làm một tấm áp phích về bảo vệ môi trường. Em viết những câu ngắn, còn bạn em vẽ tranh. Sau đó, chúng em trình bày sản phẩm trước lớp. lessons.title: Lesson 24: What We Do in School Rooms
lessons.topic: What We Do in School Rooms
lessons.passage: Good morning. There are many rooms in my school, and we do different things in each room. We read books quietly in the library. We use computers in the computer room. In the art room, we draw pictures and make crafts. In the music room, we sing songs. We study different subjects in the classroom and play games in the playground. Every school room helps us learn and have fun.

Trong phòng mỹ thuật, chúng em vẽ tranh và làm đồ thủ công. Trong phòng âm nhạc, chúng em hát các bài hát. Chúng em học các môn khác nhau trong lớp học và chơi trò chơi ở sân chơi. Mỗi phòng học giúp chúng em học tập và vui chơi. UNIT 7 • LESSON 25: My Favourite School Activity

lessons.title: Lesson 23: Where Are the School Rooms?
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Today I want to tell you where the school rooms are. The school office is on the ground floor near the gate. The library is next to the office, and the art room is opposite the library. The computer room is on the first floor between the music room and my classroom. Our playground is behind the school building. Now I can find every room easily in my school.

Thư viện ở bên cạnh văn phòng, và phòng mỹ thuật đối diện với thư viện. Phòng máy tính ở tầng một, nằm giữa phòng âm nhạc và lớp học của em. Sân chơi ở phía sau tòa nhà trường. Bây giờ em có thể dễ dàng tìm thấy mọi phòng trong trường. UNIT 6 • LESSON 24: What We Do in School Rooms

lessons.title: Lesson 22: My Favourite School Room
lessons.passage: Good morning. Today I would like to talk about my favourite room at school. It is the library. The library is on the first floor, next to the computer room. There are many shelves with storybooks, science books, and English books. I often go there during break time or after class. I like reading and finding information for my school projects. The library is quiet, cool, and very useful.

lessons.title: Lesson 21: A Tour of My School
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Welcome to my school. It is not very large, but it has many useful rooms. On the ground floor, there is a school office, a library, and an art room. The computer room and music room are on the first floor. Behind the main building, there is a big playground. My school rooms are clean and bright, so I enjoy studying here.

lessons.title: Lesson 20: My Job Dream for the Future
lessons.topic: My Job Dream for the Future
lessons.passage: Good morning. Children often change their dream jobs, and I do too. Sometimes I want to be a pilot because I want to fly to many places. Sometimes I want to be an engineer and build useful things. I also like art, so I think about becoming an artist. No matter what job I choose, I want to do something useful for other people. That is why I will keep learning and trying my best every day.

Đôi khi em muốn trở thành kỹ sư và xây dựng những thứ hữu ích. Em cũng thích nghệ thuật, vì vậy em nghĩ đến việc trở thành một nghệ sĩ. Dù chọn công việc nào, em muốn làm điều gì đó có ích cho người khác. Đó là lý do em sẽ tiếp tục học hỏi và cố gắng hết sức mỗi ngày. UNIT 6 • LESSON 21: A Tour of My School

lessons.title: Lesson 19: A Firefighter Is a Brave Person
lessons.topic: A Firefighter Is a Brave Person
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. Another job I admire is a firefighter. Firefighters put out fires and rescue people in danger. They work at a fire station and wear special uniforms. This job is difficult and sometimes dangerous, so firefighters must be brave and strong. They also help people learn about safety. I respect firefighters because they protect our community. They are very important in our lives.

Công việc này khó và đôi khi nguy hiểm, vì vậy lính cứu hỏa phải dũng cảm và khỏe mạnh. Họ cũng giúp mọi người tìm hiểu về an toàn. Em tôn trọng lính cứu hỏa vì họ bảo vệ cộng đồng. Họ rất quan trọng trong cuộc sống của chúng ta. UNIT 5 • LESSON 20: My Job Dream for the Future
ENGLISH DICTATION PRACTICE • IMPORT READY

lessons.title: Lesson 18: My Dream Job: A Doctor
lessons.passage: Good morning. My dream is to become a doctor. Doctors help sick people and give them useful advice. I want to work in a hospital near my hometown. To become a doctor, I need to study Science and English well. I also need to be careful, responsible, and kind. I know this job is not easy, but I am ready to work hard. I hope my future job can help many people.

lessons.title: Lesson 17: I Want to Be a Teacher
lessons.topic: I Want to Be a Teacher
lessons.passage: Hello everyone. When I grow up, I want to be a teacher. I like helping younger children learn new things. A good teacher is kind, patient, and creative. Teachers explain lessons and encourage pupils to do their best. To follow my dream, I will study hard and read more books. I hope I can help my future pupils feel happy and confident at school.
